en.headline: HKMA and Malaysia's central bank widen fraud and market ties
en.dek: The authorities said they would set up a policy group on compliant cross-border stablecoin uses and strengthen links between payment systems.
body: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority and Bank Negara Malaysia agreed on Tuesday to deepen cooperation on financial technology, fraud and market links, after a bilateral meeting in Hong Kong.

The two sides said they would set up a policy-focused joint working group to promote compliant cross-border stablecoin use cases between Hong Kong and Malaysia, and would step up exchanges on tokenisation and digital currencies. They also plan to explore data-based applications that could widen trade-finance access for small and medium-sized firms.

On supervision, they said they would build arrangements to strengthen cross-border cyber resilience and work against scams and fraud, encourage wider use of regional currencies in bilateral trade and investment, and improve connectivity between the two real-time gross settlement systems. They will also study a link between Hong Kong's Central Moneymarkets Unit and Malaysia's real-time funds and securities transfer system.

HKMA chief executive Eddie Yue said he welcomed the Malaysian delegation and looked forward to progress on fintech and digital-asset cooperation, local-currency settlement, market connectivity and Islamic finance.

zh.headline: 金管局與馬來西亞央行加強打擊騙案及市場聯通
zh.dek: 雙方宣布成立政策工作小組，推動合規跨境穩定幣應用，並加強即時支付結算系統之間的聯通。
body: 金管局與馬來西亞國家銀行星期二在香港舉行雙邊會議後，同意在金融科技、打擊騙案及市場聯通方面加強合作。
雙方表示，會成立以政策為重點的聯合工作小組，推動香港與馬來西亞之間合規的跨境穩定幣應用，並加強代幣化及數碼貨幣方面的政策與監管交流，亦會探索以數據為本的應用，以擴大中小企取得貿易融資的渠道。
監管方面，雙方會建立機制加強跨境網絡防衛，打擊騙案及欺詐，並促進雙邊貿易及投資更廣泛使用區內貨幣，加強兩地即時支付結算系統之間的聯通。雙方亦會探討香港債務工具中央結算系統與馬來西亞即時資金和證券轉帳系統之間建立連接。
金管局總裁余偉文說，歡迎馬來西亞央行代表團到訪，並期待在金融科技及數碼資產、區內貨幣結算、市場聯通及伊斯蘭金融方面推進合作。
